decisions.reason: SOL uses the glossary-matched “swift ship” naturally and preserves the vessel description.
“Concerning” preserves the source sense in natural English.
SOL keeps the City Lord’s dismissive complaint while making the scope of trivial details idiomatic.
SOL changes the Korean joke into a question about an order; BASE preserves the words-versus-fart gag.
“Lost himself in carnal pleasures” naturally conveys his prolonged fixation on women.
“Off to embrace” naturally conveys the predicted destination and intent.
“Snow-white skin peeking through the sheets” preserves the visual image naturally.
“You’ve worked so hard” is a natural affectionate rendering of the concubine’s sympathy.
SOL preserves the seductive, lingering eye-smile in more natural English.
“Enjoyed a smooth path through life” accurately renders the 탄탄대로 image.
“Pleasure houses” is a natural equivalent for 기방 in this context.
SOL clearly preserves that each woman held his interest for less than a year.
The Korean says he had never seen a woman like her; “known” changes the source’s visual denotation.
SOL naturally conveys both his lack of fatigue and his increasingly deep entanglement.
“Had just entered his fifties” preserves the timing and reads naturally.
“Nestled” and “intimate secrets” preserve the bewitched intimacy in idiomatic English.
“Such a difficult time” preserves the emphatic sympathy without changing the meaning.
“Shook his head in disgust” is a concise natural rendering of the action and attitude.
“Whatever else happens, I must submit” preserves his insistence naturally.
“This become a serious matter” is a natural rendering of the concern about escalation.
“Rise to become one of the Three Excellencies” preserves the intended advancement.
“Cares so much about me” naturally conveys her concern for him.
SOL preserves the mutually indifferent government–Murim relationship in natural English.
The punctuation change is idiomatic and preserves the two coordinated imperatives.
“Bring the situation under control” accurately conveys 진정시키다 in this officialized account.
“Invite suspicion” strengthens 오해 살 수도 beyond “might cause misunderstandings”; BASE preserves the hedge and sense.
BASE preserves 이미 and 오래, showing that his mind had already been blank for some time.
“Reached out to grope” is a natural rendering of the hand movement.
“The smile on his concubine’s lips deepened” preserves the expression naturally.
The following SOL hunk retains the City Lord’s failure to notice, so the deletion loses no source content.
SOL carries the omitted failure-to-notice action into the sentence while preserving the ominous image.
“Let out a peal of laughter” naturally conveys her loud, mocking 깔깔 laugh.
“Exactly as she wanted” preserves the deliberate direction of events and the correction to that person.
“Gliding unhindered” accurately conveys 막힘없이 while retaining the swift ships.
“Pondered the question” is a natural contextual recast of 고민하는 내게.
“Smiled benevolently at” is idiomatic and preserves the action.
“Neither of you will ever forget” preserves the threat of an unforgettable day.
“Still smiling brightly” maintains the ongoing expression naturally.
The plural “these humble servants” matches the group of pirates addressed.
“Stared back in confusion” naturally conveys their bewildered response.
The article makes the spoken question idiomatic without changing the joke.
Adding “in the water” clarifies the physical dunking action without changing it.
The shortened subject remains clear from context and preserves both injuries.
“Swarmed them” and “turned my attention” make the action sequence natural without losing content.
“Has not yet been named” and “inspect it” are natural System wording for the same prompt.
“A suit of armor” and the active ownership wording make the System description idiomatic while preserving its facts.
“It became bound to me” naturally states the implied new owner without changing the question.
“Suspected as much” is a natural equivalent of having wondered whether that was the case.
김빠진 소리 denotes a deflated reaction, not a dumbfounded one; BASE preserves the attitude.
Both versions replace the source’s dative question with unrelated “What?” or “Huh?”; this preserves the implied ownership question.
“Had once been called” naturally conveys that the fragment’s former name was Black Dragon Armor.
The Korean says he blasted it away together with the Demon Lord; “blasted it apart” changes the physical action.
“Tucked down the front of my underwear” preserves the crude joke in natural English.
The Korean says he tugged at the front of his pants; “tugged open” adds an unsupported opening action.
“Approaching us” makes the implied direction clear without changing the scene.
SOL preserves the glossary title “Slaughter Saint” and naturally describes the instantaneous disguise.
“Couldn’t do it three times” preserves the source’s inability; SOL weakens it into advice not to do it.
“Was fixed on” preserves the locked gaze in natural English.
SOL correctly applies the established System capitalization for Item.
“Came to remain” preserves the question of how only a fragment was left.
“Spoke of a mysterious suit of armor” naturally preserves the old-history attribution and changing properties.
“Embodied their form and nature” naturally expresses the owner’s internal energy as that essence.
The source says the energy flowed toward the fragment; “into” changes the physical direction.
“Engraved with a pattern resembling blazing flames” accurately and vividly renders the transformed surface.
“The moment I smiled” preserves the simultaneous timing naturally.
SOL restores the source’s explicit chime immediately before the System notices.
SOL preserves the System labels and uses emphasis consistently for the newly named Item.
The source describes energy rushing toward the armor; SOL changes that direction to surging into it.
품에 means into his arms or bosom, not inside his clothes; BASE preserves the concealment action.
SOL preserves the source’s startled exclamation rather than flattening it into an ellipsis.
“Was starting to think I might” preserves the tentative realization in 중독될 것 같아.
“Swift ship” matches the glossary, and “drew a deep breath” is natural English for 심호흡했다.
